description: This script is a setup and test script for a Git repository, testing handling of file paths including absolute and relative paths, as well as files outside the repository's work tree. It sets up test cases for Git commands such as add, remove, ls-files, commit, log, and blame, with a focus on path sanitization and handling.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: A testing function that runs a block of commands expecting success.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new Git repository for testing.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Ensures the tested command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares output files to expected files to verify test outcomes.
